bagPolicy.summary: Bags must fit under your seat and be no larger than 22" x 14" x 9". Oversized bags are prohibited.
allowed: Bags up to 22" x 14" x 9" that fit under your seat
bagPolicy.note: This is the bag rule printed on MSG event pages (the MSG FAQ does not show it as text). The full prohibited items list is on the MSG FAQ page.

parking.note: Madison Square Garden offers several parking options nearby, with varying prices depending on the event and location. It's advisable to book parking in advance to secure a spot and potentially save on costs. Street parking is limited, so using a nearby garage is recommended.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Madison Square Garden's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Madison Square Garden offers a variety of food and drink options, including classic stadium fare and unique culinary experiences. Highlights include gourmet hot dogs, artisanal pizzas, and a selection of craft beers. Special offerings may include local New York favorites and seasonal menu items.

accessibility.title: ADA & Accessible Services
accessibility.body: Wheelchair accessible entrances on all sides. Assistive listening devices available. Wheelchair escorts on request. Disabled Services: 212-465-6034.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: No re-entry. Exiting MSG voids your ticket.

ticketPickup.title: Will Call
ticketPickup.body: Box Office at 7th Ave & 31st St. Opens 2 hrs before event. Photo ID required.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Main entrance on 7th Avenue. Multiple accessible entrances on all sides. Gates open 1–2 hrs before showtime.
